metadata.description: Deep callback session focusing on churn rate analysis with long-distance retrievals

turns.content: First, what was our churn rate in Q1 2024? Calculate and note it.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate and note Q1 2024 churn rate

turns.content: For churn analysis, use subscription.status IN ('cancelled', 'expired').

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use both statuses for churn

turns.content: Also exclude trial accounts from all churn analyses.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out trial tier

turns.content: Show me churn by account tier for Q1.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show Q1 churn by tier

turns.content: Now show me feature usage patterns for Q1 accounts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze Q1 feature usage

turns.content: Which features are most used by retained accounts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show top features for retained accounts

turns.content: What's the geographic distribution of churned accounts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show churned accounts by region

turns.content: Show me account tenure distribution for churned accounts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show how long churned accounts stayed

turns.content: What was the Q1 churn rate we established at the beginning?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall Q1 churn rate baseline

turns.content: How does Q4 compare to the Q1 baseline?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare Q4 to Q1 baseline

turns.content: Apply the same churn definition to calculate monthly churn rates.
Earlier we looked at feature usage for retained accounts. What about for churned accounts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare with feature usage for churned accounts

turns.content: What was the Q1 baseline churn rate again?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall Q1 churn rate

turns.content: Create a chart comparing churn by quarter.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create quarter comparison visualization

turns.content: Thank you. We've established that churn rate increased from 4.2% in Q1 to 6.8% in Q4, with Enterprise tier showing the largest increase and low feature adoption being the strongest predictor.

persistedCorrections.description: Use both statuses for churn definition

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Exclude trial accounts from all churn analyses
